searchText: only skimmed this and need to run but looks like this PR touches this point: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/337 Teku/erigon pair throwing this error: ```2023-01-06 08:46:06.272 ERROR - Failed to update eth1 chain head java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "org.web3j.protocol.core.methods.response.EthBlock$Block.getTimestamp()" because "headBlock" is null at tech.pegasys.teku.beacon.pow.TimeBasedEth1HeadTracker.isOldEnough(TimeBasedEth1HeadTracker.java:189) ~[teku-beacon-pow-develop.jar:22.12.0+68-g16fc563] at tech.pegasys.teku.beacon.pow.TimeBasedEth1HeadTracker.lambda$init$0(TimeBasedEth1HeadTracker.java:76) ~[teku-beacon-pow-develop.jar:22.12.0+68-g16fc563]``` Anyone from teku/erigon could take a look? It constantly crashing the beacon. and can't seem to sync beyond a certain block Seems basically fine This is going in the capella rc release today. I think we should shift to rc-0 for devnets asap (next week?) We would like to begin a new devnet with as many final specs as possible. I'm all for starting up devnet2 and shutting down devnet1 if we have at least 2/2 clients that have all final specs implemented. If we only have a single client from either EL or CL then I don't see much reason to push it already for early next week. Please client teams reach out and let us know what your pgoress on rc-0. With the change to the beacon state definition in 3165 I'd like to see the `BeaconState` SSZ data in `consensus-spec-tests` updated. Are with testing Capella with mev-boost/relayer/builder yet? if not, do we have a timeline. This is something I'd love to start ealrier this time since we all felt a bit rushed for Bellatrix. cc <@388610194608750595> i'm working w/ chris on the mev-boost capella changes, there are some community contributions to update the specs/APIs that he and i have been working on and i'll see what i can do to help him push along remote builder software so that we have something to test in the next few weeks we're basically querying latest block, and getting back null constantly... admittedly an NPE is bad, posted in our teku chat as a start Teku should sync optimistically and verify based on el when it caught up no? Prysm and lodestar was able to sync to head with erigon. i can look at where its at now, i only looked at first npe, im not sure if it resolved its basically just spamming that npe and crashing because it expected a block and didnt get one looks like eth1 hasn't progressed, need some coffee then can have a think <@412614104222531604> I think now is a good time to rebuild the nimbus image again - we've pushed a number of fixes to unstable that ideally should result in capella validators working as well - how is the valdiator key assignment done? can you switch a few vals to a nimbus instance? We have a couple thousand running on nimbus I’ll rebuild and redeploy oh? I didn't think it would work given we didn't call the right getpayload until today 😉 Never said it worked lol Just said that it was already present point taken 🙂 do you have some validator numbers and an explorer up your sleeve? Restarted with new images Explorer we couldn’t make it working stable enough. Hopefully next week we can get something sorted for devnet 2 and public net Validator indexes are in https://github.com/ethpandaops/withdrawals-testnet/blob/master/withdrawal-devnet-1/generate_keys.sh https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/4472 - nimbus changes needed for historical batches Would you mind checking the nodes if they are all syncing ? I’m already on mobile only and looking at docker logs is rather difficult Nethermind/nimbus doesn’t look very good from afar I'm allergic to docker (and it's 23:33 here) so er.. not today 😉 Here too. Have a good weekend. indeed, you too! been a good week for compatibility on our end 😉 Well done!
